/*selectMasterCmClTaxBillNoDetailPopList*/
SELECT
GR.BUYER AS BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = GR.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, GR.PO_NO AS PO_NO, GR.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, GR.GR_NO AS GR_NO, GR.GR_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, GR.AGENT AS AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = GR.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, GR.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, GR.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, GR.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, GR.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, GR.ITEM_QTY AS GR_QTY, GR.ITEM_AMT AS ITEM_AMT, GR.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, GR.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, GR.LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, GR.LEGACY_GR_SEQ AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, (SELECT PLANT FROM ICOMPODT PO WHERE PO.BUYER = GR.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = GR.PO_NO AND PO.PO_SEQ = GR.PO_SEQ AND PO.STATUS <> 'D') AS PLANT
FROM ICOMGRDT GR
WHERE GR.STATUS <> 'D' AND GR.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND GR.AR_TAX_BILL_NO = #{st_tax_bill_no} ORDER BY GR.BUYER, GR.GR_NO, GR.GR_SEQ
